scope: Explicit production Solid dependency selection; one generated JavaScript module is executed with ordinary Bun and passed to the actual Bun AOT compiler. All twelve GPUI/XTest/full-tree paint/OS-close cases ran once with unchanged source and artifacts.
sourceStability: Manifest sources, actual controllers/driver/supervisor/inspectors, host, generated modules and AOT binaries were hashed before and after every run. No qualified product or controller source changed.

historicalFrameworkInspection.meaning: The earlier native/AOT correctness remains valid for its recorded development-framework module. The JSX preset dev:false did not select production Solid exports; prior records are not relabelled.

dependencySelectionControl.meaning: Under caller NODE_ENV=test, browser and browser+production conditions alone select development. Explicit NODE_ENV production definition selects the production dependency and constant. The checked-in test also inspects the actual native TSX bundle.

limits: Both runtime modes select production Solid modules. Development names ordinary Bun execution, not a development Solid build; AOT additionally has the compiled-program flag and unused JIT with 27 removed ranges. The interpreter remains present.

The immutable native host is development profile with software Vulkan. This is not a hosted release-host qualification, matched performance comparison, startup/latency improvement or release footprint baseline.

XTest and native paint traversal do not qualify physical input, display presentation, hardware GPU performance, IME, accessibility or macOS/Windows Solid behavior. Screenshots are retained; automated pixel/OCR assertions remain unsupported.
Bounded owner cleanup and zero observed child survivors are not proof of complete managed/native allocation reclamation. Shared retention issue287 and its unchanged oracle remain open.
